core_meaning.primary_meaning: Moncef corresponds to the Arabic form منصف and is glossed in this record as “Fair, just, equitable.” The record associates the form with root ن ص ف (n-ṣ-f). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Moncef corresponds to the Arabic form منصف (Arabic root ن ص ف (n-ṣ-f); مُنْصِف (Munṣif)). Its core sense is fairness, justice, equity. Moncef is Arabic مُنْصِف (Munṣif) 'fair, just, equitable', from the root ن ص ف (n-ṣ-f). The source gloss 'Gifted' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: منصف
